style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist named Sara, huge white round eyes, exactly like the reference image, NO clothing of any kind, NEVER a human character. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English, and only when the scene explicitly asks for specific words. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. CRITICAL: NEVER draw a calendar, a torn-calendar page, or any day-counter with a number on it unless the scene explicitly asks for one. CRITICAL: NEVER use any real brand name or logo (no Microsoft logo, no Windows logo, no Outlook logo) — use generic icons only (a plain server tower, a plain envelope, a plain shield). CRITICAL about the shadow figure representing the anonymous attacker: its face must ALWAYS stay completely hidden inside a black hood silhouette, its entire body/hood is always solid BLACK, never brown/white/gray, only two glowing YELLOW eyes visible. Never place two characters in a scene that says 'no characters' — treat that literally, icon-only, no monkey, no hacker, no people at all in those frames. Never add a speech bubble, caption, or extra label unless the scene explicitly asks for one.

frames.text: Este fallo permite a un atacante capturar ese sello mientras viaja por la red y reutilizarlo después para hacerse pasar por ti.
